description: 2020 Adjusted Urban Area is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Caltrans is responsible for the decennial production of the Adjusted Urban Area Boundaries for the State of California. The CA 2020 adjusted urban area file represents the current Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) approved Caltrans adjusted urban area boundaries. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Adjusted Urban Boundaries, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, Caltrans HQ, CAOpenData, FHWA. The bounding box given is -124.2559,32.5340,-114.2769,41.8695. The hub shows 2024-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (The CA 2020 Adjusted Urban Area boundaries is made available to the public solely for informational purposes.
